run_filter_lexicon: run the script to filter a lexicon file using a unit dictionary via stdin
run_get_parser: run get_parser to create an argparse parser with a required unit-dict argument
run_main: run main to load a unit dictionary and filter lexicon lines from stdin
review_filter_lexicon: review the filter_lexicon script that filters lexicon entries against a fairseq unit dictionary
summarize_main: summarize the main function that loads a Dictionary and filters stdin lines by symbol membership
